purpose: Public incident-response and disclosure-lane contract for privacy, security, payment-provider, evidence-integrity, unsafe-disclosure, availability, and copilot-output incidents.

intakeChannels.label: Safety page report
intakeChannels.rule: Route safety, coercion, disclosure, and externality concerns into human review without publishing private details.

intakeChannels.label: Privacy or data-right request
intakeChannels.rule: Route access, correction, deletion, and suspected leakage issues through the privacy/data-right lane.

intakeChannels.label: Admin console report
intakeChannels.rule: Route blocked wish profiles, payment-review requests, failed notifications, and abuse reports into an operator queue.

intakeChannels.label: Provider alert
intakeChannels.rule: Capture Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Every.org, email, or monitoring alerts as provider-boundary incident inputs.

intakeChannels.label: Validator health blocker
intakeChannels.rule: Escalate failing public health validators when they could affect reliance, disclosure, completion, or public trust claims.

incidentCategories.label: Payment provider error
examples: Stripe or donation provider webhook failure

severityLevels.label: SEV0 active sensitive exposure
severityLevels.publicSummary: Active exposure of private wishes, source notes, contact details, payment-sensitive data, or auth bypass.

severityLevels.label: SEV1 control or payment failure
severityLevels.publicSummary: Security, payment, disclosure, or evidence-control failure that may affect participant trust or reliance.

severityLevels.label: SEV2 review integrity issue
severityLevels.publicSummary: Incorrect review, challenge, evidence, or copilot-assistance result requiring correction before reliance.

severityLevels.label: SEV3 service degradation
severityLevels.publicSummary: Route, validator, or provider degradation with no known sensitive-data exposure.

responsePhases.label: Triage and severity
responsePhases.rule: Classify category, severity, affected surfaces, reviewer owner, and whether disclosure or reliance must pause.

responsePhases.label: Containment and pause
responsePhases.rule: Pause affected matching, disclosure, completion, trust-badge, or payment reliance paths before continuing review.

responsePhases.label: Affected participant notice
responsePhases.rule: Notify affected participants with scoped facts, recommended actions, and what private data may have been involved.

responsePhases.label: Provider escalation
responsePhases.rule: Escalate provider-boundary failures to Supabase, Vercel, Stripe, Every.org, email, or monitoring providers as relevant.

responsePhases.label: Root cause and correction
responsePhases.rule: Record root cause, fixed control, regression check, reviewer approval, and unresolved residual risk.

responsePhases.label: Public aggregate update
responsePhases.rule: Publish aggregate incident counts and category/severity summaries without raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, or payment secrets.

responsePhases.label: Validator and backlog update
responsePhases.rule: Add or update validator checks, tests, or scale-gate blockers so the same incident cannot silently recur.

disclosureRules.label: Affected participant notice required
disclosureRules.rule: SEV0 and SEV1 incidents require affected-participant notice unless doing so would increase harm or conflict with law.

disclosureRules.label: Public aggregate only
disclosureRules.rule: Public reporting uses counts, category, severity, status, and remediation class; raw private records stay redacted.

disclosureRules.label: No private details in public postmortem
disclosureRules.rule: Do not publish private wishes, source notes, exact contact details, payment secrets, hidden reviewer notes, or raw provider payloads.

disclosureRules.label: Validator blockers linked
disclosureRules.rule: If the incident exposed a contract gap, link the public blocker, test, or scale gate that now tracks the fix.

disclosureRules.label: Human review before reopening
disclosureRules.rule: Affected matching, disclosure, completion, payment, or trust-badge paths reopen only after human review confirms containment.

readinessGates.label: Trust-badge incident lane
readinessGates.rule: Do not expand trust badges without a published incident lane for review errors, privacy leakage, and contract blockers.

readinessGates.label: Paid-action incident lane
readinessGates.rule: Do not expand paid actions without payment-provider escalation, participant notice, and correction records.

readinessGates.label: Copilot-assist incident lane
readinessGates.rule: Do not promote copilot assistance unless output violations are routed to containment and regression checks.

publicNonClaims: Moral Trade does not claim 24/7 staffed security operations.
Moral Trade does not claim zero incidents or zero residual security risk.
Moral Trade does not publish raw private wishes, source notes, contact details, payment secrets, or provider payloads in public incident summaries.
Moral Trade does not treat incident-response publication as proof that MFA, device/session review, key rotation, or field-level encryption are complete.
